title: From hyperplanes to hyperellipsoids: a pedagogical bridge from linear classifiers to single-qubit mixed-state classifiers
summary: Quantum machine learning ideas are typically absent from traditional machine learning curricula and are instead introduced in upper-level courses on quantum information processing and quantum computing. We propose a route for bringing quantum ideas into the standard machine learning classroom directly after the introduction of binary linear classifiers. Specifically, we develop a pedagogical bridge between linear classifiers and single-qubit mixed-state classifiers by characterizing their geometric model structure.
